lines: Accounts: username, display name and e-mail from the sign-in provider (GitHub today).
Participation: signups, draws, ballots and judges' scores.
Guests: the name entered and a personal link scoped to one session; leaving, or being removed by the head, deletes both.
No analytics trackers, no advertising, no sale or transfer of data. One cookie: the session cookie.
Export, correction or deletion — write to support@uadebate.com; answered within 30 days.
